title: Infinity Machine: a self-improving AI agent for research
abstract: arXiv:2610.35579v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI agent that we use for research on problems whose answers aprogram or data can check. Each candidate solution is produced by a full tool-using agent that works for up to an hour in a fresh sandbox; proposers see only a public score, and a private split decides what counts. The harness itself(prompts, tools, skills, playbook, meta agent) is an editable genome, changed only through a kernel-enforced gate with held-out and cost checks. An autonomous mode goes from a plain-text goal to a verified report with no human step: an agent picks an open problem and writes its verifier, the kernel calibrates it, an adversarial agent audits it, and an agent that never sees the verifier re-checks the result. Across fourteen problems in six days, for about $180 of model usage, the system produced four results beyond the published state of the art on catalogued open problems in quantum information: a ce

translated_title: 无限机器：一个自我改进的研究型AI智能体
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“无限机器”，这是一个自我改进的AI智能体，我们用它来研究那些答案可以被程序或数据验证的问题。每个候选解决方案都由一个完整的工具使用型智能体生成，该智能体在全新沙箱中工作长达一小时；提议者只能看到公开分数，而私有数据划分决定什么才算有效结果。该框架本身（提示词、工具、技能、操作手册、元智能体）是一个可编辑的基因组，只能通过内核强制执行的门控进行修改，门控包含保留集检验和成本检验。自主模式可以从纯文本目标直接生成经过验证的报告，全程无需人工环节：一个智能体选择一个开放问题并编写其验证器，内核对其进行校准，一个对抗性智能体对其进行审计，最后由一个从未见过该验证器的智能体重新检查结果。在六天内针对十四个问题，仅花费约180美元的模型使用费用，该系统在量子信息领域已编目的开放问题上产生了四项超越已发表最先进水平的结果：一个ce（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 论文提出“无限机器”——一个可自主演化的自我改进AI研究智能体，其框架通过内核强制门控自动修改、全程无人工介入，六天内仅耗约180美元便在量子信息开放问题上取得四项超越已发表最先进水平的成果。
en_tdlr: The paper presents the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI research agent whose harness autonomously evolves through a kernel-enforced gate with no human steps, producing four results beyond the published state of the art on open problems in quantum information within six days for about $180.
